services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: At Shem Creek Boat Rentals, we have boat rentals of all different sizes available for your next adventure on the waters of the Lowcountry. We also provide boundaries and our staff will go over a chart, informing your of your location before you head out onto the water. Our boats can be rented for any allotment of time - from a one-hour trip around Shem Creek to a full-day of fishing in the Cooper River. We have partnered with Sea Fox Boat Company to bring the best possible boating experience to you.
